profile.about: I am a software engineer with a degree in Game and around five years of professional Unity/C# game development experience, building gameplay, multiplayer, and reusable application systems. My recent work has expanded my production software engineering capabilities through enterprise architecture, API and data integration, and applied AI workflows using OCR, LLMs, structured output, validation, and normalization. My long-term direction is to combine these backgrounds in Game AI, with particular interest in intelligent agents, procedural content generation, adaptive gameplay, and AI-assisted game systems.

interests.title: Game AI
interests.description: AI for gameplay systems that can reason from player experience and game state while operating under explicit rules, constraints, and measurable design objectives.

interests.title: Procedural Content Generation
interests.description: Generation of skill, class, and other gameplay candidates from structured components, with variation guided by player experience rather than a fixed progression tree alone.

interests.title: AI-assisted Game Systems
interests.description: Hybrid game systems where generative suggestions are checked through game-rule validation, power budgets, balance evaluation, and simulation before becoming playable candidates.

interests.title: Intelligent Agents
interests.description: Agents that could perceive game state, reason about available actions, and make meaningful decisions within authored gameplay constraints.

interests.title: Adaptive Gameplay
interests.description: Gameplay and progression that could respond to observed player behaviour while preserving fairness, clarity, and designer intent.

interests.title: Multi-Agent Systems
interests.description: Interactions among multiple autonomous agents operating with shared rules, resources, environments, and gameplay objectives.

research.statement: My primary interest is in experience-driven, rule-constrained gameplay systems: using structured player experience to explore skill and class progression while keeping generated candidates valid, balanced, and designer-controllable.

direction.title: Generative Class & Skill System for Fantasy RPG
direction.question: How might a hybrid Generative AI and rule-validation system propose class and skill candidates from gameplay experience while keeping them valid, balanced, diverse, and designer-controllable?
direction.supportingStatement: The proposed Fantasy RPG prototype would turn observed gameplay into a structured experience representation, generate candidates from reusable game components, then validate, balance-check, and simulate them before they could become playable.
